title: Subcellularly Resolved Single-Cell Embedding Learning with Transcriptomic data, Protein Structure and Localization Information
abstract: arXiv:2609.02344v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing cell embedding methods predominantly rely on transcriptomic or proteomic measurements and represent each cell as a holistic entity, thereby overlooking the subcellular localization of individual molecules. Moreover, they rarely incorporate protein structural information, despite its fundamental role in determining molecular interactions and functions. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework for learning subcellularly resolved cell embeddings by jointly leveraging RNA expression profiles, protein sequence representations, and protein structural information. Specifically, we employ a cross-attention architecture to integrate transcriptomic, sequence, and structural modalities and model their interactions within distinct subcellular compartments. translated_title: 基于转录组数据、蛋白质结构与定位信息的亚细胞分辨率单细胞嵌入学习
translated_abstract: 现有的细胞嵌入方法主要依赖转录组或蛋白质组测量，并将每个细胞表示为一个整体实体，从而忽略了单个分子的亚细胞定位。此外，尽管蛋白质结构信息在决定分子相互作用和功能方面起着根本性作用，这些方法却很少将其纳入考虑。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个多模态框架，通过联合利用RNA表达谱、蛋白质序列表示和蛋白质结构信息来学习具有亚细胞分辨率的细胞嵌入。具体而言，我们采用交叉注意力架构来整合转录组、序列和结构三种模态，并建模它们在不同亚细胞区室内的相互作用。由此产生的嵌入通过细粒度的亚细胞组织来表示每个细胞，既捕捉了分子表达模式，也捕捉了功能特性。
tldr: 提出了一种多模态框架，通过交叉注意力架构联合利用RNA表达、蛋白质序列与结构信息，学习能够捕捉亚细胞区室分辨率的单细胞嵌入表示。
en_tdlr: A multimodal framework is proposed that jointly leverages RNA expression, protein sequence, and structural information via a cross-attention architecture to learn single-cell embeddings with subcellular resolution.
